items.name: Into the Gloaming
items.hook: Bandits, thieves, beasts, trolls, and evil spirits roam these lawless lands. No one's coming to save you—don't go alone.
items.credit: Shadowdark RPG by The Arcane Library.

items.name: A Pound of Flesh
items.hook: Shore leave on an outlaw station that loves you back… until it doesn't.

items.name: Mythic Bastionland
items.hook: The realm is old, the Myths are older, and the seers never tell you everything.

items.name: Mythic Bastionland
items.hook: You're a Knight. Not a murder-hobo. A Knight, with an oath to keep, a seer in your ear, and a Myth waiting for you out there.

items.name: While You Sleep
items.hook: Dreamwalk into a friend's nightmares and face their fears together. 16 printer-friendly pages, hand drawn and inked on paper, born in the Gold & Glory community.

items.name: Fiddler In The Bush
items.hook: A lusty satyr, a stolen queen, and a lost kingdom swallowed by a twisted forest. Yes, there's an actual fiddle, and yes, it's magical.
items.credit: Made for the Weird Tales Shadowdark Game Jam 2024.
